title: Divergence: thermite-syntax parse_block never builds tail Expr::If — if/else in value position lost as Stmt::If (surface-grammar.md REQ-5/decision 2, ast.md REQ-6)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Failing test at thermite-syntax/tests/divergence_grammar.rs::divergence_if_else_in_tail_position_is_expr. Input `{ if x==0 {1} else {2} }` yields Block{stmts:[Stmt::If..], tail:None} instead of tail Some(Expr::If). parse_block unconditionally routes TokKind::If to parse_if_stmt; the value-position if-expr (surface-grammar.md decision 2, ast.md REQ-6) is never built. The fn body has no value.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Fixed in 5bb910e: parse_block routes if+else in tail position to Expr::If as the block tail (parse_if_parts); statement-form if preserved. divergence_if_else_in_tail_position_is_expr now passes (un-ignored). Gauntlet green.
